certifiedServices.serviceDescription: System and package onboarding, FedRAMP Rev5 control and FedRAMP 20x Key Security Indicator tracking, and approval records for each package. Security category: Moderate.
Read-only collection of cloud configuration telemetry and fixed rules that decide each Key Security Indicator result. Security category: Moderate.
Scan result import, PAIN rating, remediation dates and evidence tracking aligned to the FedRAMP vulnerability detection and response and evaluation rules. Security category: Moderate.
Compliance and security ticketing with role-based approvals and separation-of-duties support. Security category: Moderate.
Role-gated library for the policies, procedures, plans and evidence files of a package. Security category: Moderate.
Staging, review and approval of certification data before it is published, with a separate portal for each agency. Certification data is shared with agencies on request. Security category: Moderate.
Answers compliance questions and drafts recommendations. All decisions are made and approved by humans. Security category: Moderate.

serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: CIPHER GRC is a software-as-a-service governance, risk, and compliance platform for cloud service providers pursuing and maintaining FedRAMP Certification. It supports FedRAMP Rev5 packages and FedRAMP 20x continuous, telemetry-based certification, including Key Security Indicator results decided by policy-as-code, vulnerability detection and response, ITSM ticketing, a document library, and a trust center with review and approval before anything is published. Humans remain the decision-makers; Traverge subject matter experts and the Alan AI assistant provide recommendations only. CIPHER GRC is a product of CIPHER Platforms Incorporated, a Traverge Company. The UEI number given is that of the parent company, Traverge Incorporated.
